author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Overwatch now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6006aEaTr

Out of the shadows comes the newest Support Hero, Doctrine, who can manipulate life itself to heal allies and damage enemies with the help of his Eternal Scepter. Dodge incoming fire with his Shrouded Momentum ability, and send out Invigorating Drones to an ally for increased attack speed and healing. 

Doctrine’s Infuse takes things to the next level by adding extra power to whichever ability he uses next, like gaining free-flight when infusing his Shrouded Momentum or piercing damage when infusing his next Eternal Scepter attack. Finally, unleash his Ultimate, Deliverance, to grant allies overhealth while reducing the maximum health of your enemies. 

Take life into your own hands when Season 5: A Grim Doctrine arrives on October 6, 2026. 

#Overwatch
